svg.title: Wiring: ESP32 board to 3.5-inch ST7796S display
svg.desc: Eight female-to-female jumper wires connect the display's 9-pin SPI header, seen from the back, to the ESP32 DevKit, seen from the top with the USB-C port at the bottom. display GND to ESP32 GND; display VCC to ESP32 3V3; display SCL to ESP32 D18 (GPIO18); display SDA to ESP32 D23 (GPIO23); display RST to ESP32 D33 (GPIO33); display DC to ESP32 D27 (GPIO27); display CS to ESP32 D5 (GPIO5); display BL to ESP32 D32 (GPIO32). Display pin SDA-O is not connected. The SCL and SDA pins are SPI, not I2C. The IM0, IM1 and IM2 jumpers on the display must all be 1 (SPI). Use a USB-C cable that carries data.
svg.text: SCL/SDA here means SPI, not I2C
USB-C: use a cable that carries data
